_: Days a forward-only stream did not collect, and CANNOT be refetched.
Every stream here serves TODAY and only today -- NSE's ASM/GSM/ban lists,
BSE's announcements feed (L72a: any past window returns 0 rows) and the
news capture. A day not collected is a day that never existed for them,
so these entries never clear and would otherwise sit in /health forever.
A monitor showing the same three lines every morning is one you stop
reading, and then the real alarm is missed too.
ACKNOWLEDGING IS NOT FIXING. The gap is still a hole in the record; this
file is what stops it being mistaken for a QUIET day (absent is not
quiet). Only the exact date+stream pairs listed here are silenced -- any
new gap still fires, and agent.py's selftest asserts exactly that.
Add an entry only after confirming the day is genuinely unrecoverable.

gaps.why: the machine was asleep for the whole session: no snapshot job ran, so ASM/GSM/ban, the BSE feed and the news capture all lost the day. The bhavcopy was refetched by --catchup and the NSE weekly filings self-healed, both being resumable; these three are not.
